summary: Checks whether a value is a sheet name.
description: What Google Sheets accepts: at most 100 characters, not blank, none of `\ / ? * [ ]`, and not the reserved name `history` in any case.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a sheet name; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isValidSheetName("Data"); // => true
isValidSheetName("Report 2026"); // => true
isValidSheetName("history"); // => false
isValidSheetName("Data/2026"); // => false
isValidSheetName(""); // => false
```
